steps.what: Locate and verify the actual patient's current dental history and available diagnostic records in the orthodontic record system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual patient identifier and existing diagnostic records

steps.what: Examine the actual patient's teeth, jaw relationships and other dental-facial features, clarifying symptoms and relevant history.
Interpret the actual diagnostic images and dental models with the clinical findings, checking image adequacy and clinical significance.
inputs: Available diagnostic images/models in orthodontic imaging software {OTHER}

steps.what: Diagnose the actual teeth, jaw or other dental-facial abnormalities, stating uncertainty and any need for further assessment.
Write the actual diagnosis, supporting findings and uncertainties in the clinical record {OTHER}.
Save the actual diagnostic note in the same clinical record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure a native patient-record view in {OTHER} to reduce a small amount of navigation. The orthodontist still examines, interprets actual images/models, diagnoses and writes the actual findings; this is not an automated image-reading or diagnostic service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current images and history may require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient views can expose existing record links.
tasks.still_hard: Growth, image limitations and clinical context determine the meaning of apparent abnormalities.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate direct examination with the evidence and recognise diagnostic uncertainty.

ambition.what: Protect examination and diagnostic reasoning time.

tasks.altitude: No clinical authority changes; only minor navigation changes.

reach.learn: Communicate diagnostic uncertainty and findings relevant to shared care.

evidence.claim: A native patient view can reduce record navigation; it does not diagnose dental-facial abnormalities.

assumptions: Boundary includes examination, actual interpretation, diagnosis and its separate written note. No free diagnostic measurements or new automated image analysis is assumed.

Existing record/imaging staff provide patient id, encounter id, image/model id, acquisition date and source link. s1 verifies identity and currentness. Missing or mismatched links are resolved manually; physical models are still retrieved and examined.

Conditional E1 shares. Only 1 point of navigation changes; existing viewer runtime earns no labour saving. Native configuration is tested first; ordinary note storage is fully retained and has no self-approval gate.
unknowns: Are current images already linked to the patient record?
research_questions: Does the view reduce navigation without obscuring missing or outdated diagnostic evidence?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence checks, examination, interpretation, diagnosis and note writing

incremental.description: Check patient/image link behaviour after record updates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 1 minus 0.2 upkeep gives 0.8. Conservative case: diagnostic images are already immediately linked, so no navigation change is adopted. All examination, image interpretation, diagnostic reasoning and note content remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study diagnostic records to develop treatment plans

steps.what: Assemble the actual medical/dental histories, plaster models, face/teeth photographs and X-rays for this patient, checking patient identity and acquisition dates in {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing actual patient diagnostic records and physical models

steps.what: Study the actual histories, plaster models, photos and X-rays, integrating growth, occlusion and clinical limitations rather than accepting a software appearance as a treatment goal.
inputs: Actual diagnostic record set from s1
outputs: Actual clinical interpretation and treatment constraints

steps.what: Develop actual patient treatment options and a proposed plan from the interpreted diagnostic evidence and patient needs.
inputs: Actual interpretation and constraints from s2
outputs: Actual proposed treatment plan and alternatives

steps.what: Write the actual proposed plan, alternatives, rationale and limitations in the orthodontic record {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual plan and alternatives from s3

steps.what: Save the actual proposed plan in the same orthodontic record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure the native patient-study collection in {OTHER} to bring together existing digital diagnostic records. Physical model handling, substantive study, treatment planning and actual plan writing remain with the orthodontist; no model invents measurements or treatment options.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records from different acquisitions can require repeated locating and identity checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing patient-study links can group digital sources by identity and date.
tasks.still_hard: Record completeness does not establish a suitable treatment strategy.
tasks.human_edge: Reconcile conflicting diagnostic evidence with growth and patient priorities.

ambition.what: Make the actual diagnostic record set easier to inspect.

tasks.altitude: Less digital source assembly; treatment decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Present the diagnostic evidence and uncertainty relevant to specialist discussion.

evidence.claim: Patient-study collections can group existing digital records without replacing physical model examination or clinical treatment planning.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual record assembly, physical and digital study, treatment-plan development and written plan. No acquisition, plaster-model handling or diagnostic interpretation is removed.

Existing acquisition staff supply patient id, study id, modality, date and source link. s1 checks those links and still retrieves physical models. Missing metadata or incompatible images require manual assembly; no free digitisation is assumed.

Conditional E1 estimates; the s1 cut is limited to digital source locating while identity checking and physical retrieval remain. Native settings precede custom integration and existing automatic links earn no saving. Internal plan saving is fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which diagnostic sources can be linked natively?
research_questions: Does the study view preserve patient identity and acquisition chronology across photographs, images and model records?

already_counted.description: Retained assembly checks, all diagnostic study, actual planning and plan writing

incremental.description: Check study/modality links after acquisition-system changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.30 = 4.5 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 4. Conservative case: legacy photographs, outside X-rays and physical models have incompatible identity metadata, requiring full manual assembly; retain the present workflow rather than assuming a linked collection. The 55-share substantive study stays unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide treatment plans and cost estimates

steps.what: Verify the actual proposed treatment plan, alternatives and patient identity in the orthodontic record {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual clinician-developed treatment plan and patient record

steps.what: Enter the actual intended procedures, quantities, stages and relevant price-table entries in the treatment-estimate workspace {OTHER}.
outputs: Actual estimate items and applicable price references

steps.what: Calculate the actual cost estimate from selected procedure quantities and current price-table entries using native estimate arithmetic {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual selected estimate items and price references from s2
outputs: Draft itemised cost estimate and totals

steps.what: Populate the patient-facing proposed treatment plan and estimate document from the actual plan and calculated items using native templates {OTHER}.
outputs: Complete draft plan and cost-estimate document

steps.what: Explain the proposed treatment plan, alternatives, estimate and uncertainties to the patient, checking questions and understanding.
outputs: Actual explanation and any required changes

steps.what: Resolve actual changes in {OTHER} and check the complete patient-facing document against the clinical plan, quantities, current prices, caveats and intended recipient before release.
inputs: Actual questions and required changes from s5
Original plan and price references from s1-s2
outputs: Complete checked patient document v1 and release decision

steps.what: Save the completed document in the same orthodontic record {OTHER}.
inputs: Unchanged final document v1 from s6

steps.what: Send the exact checked treatment-plan and estimate document to the verified patient destination using the existing secure patient exchange {OTHER}.
inputs: Release decision and verified recipient from s6
outputs: Patient receives the proposed treatment plan and estimate

tasks.design: Configure native item-price arithmetic and plan/estimate templates in {OTHER}. The orthodontist supplies the real treatment scope, explains it to the patient and checks the completed generated document before the separate secure send; the ordinary internal save has no approval gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected procedures and prices may be manually totalled and copied into patient documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native estimate arithmetic and templates can reuse explicitly selected items without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A proposed estimate depends on actual treatment choices and cannot guarantee insurer payment or final treatment needs.
tasks.human_edge: Explain alternatives, clinical uncertainty and financial implications without implying guaranteed outcomes.

ambition.what: Offer itemised costs alongside the actual clinically suitable alternative discussed with the patient.

tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic and document assembly; clinical and price explanation stay human.

reach.learn: Distinguish a practice estimate from coverage or outcome guarantees.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for price tables, patient data and secure exchange

evidence.claim: Explicit procedure quantities and price references support deterministic estimates and patient-document generation.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual plan/price selection, estimate calculation, document generation, patient explanation, completed-document checking and the actual secure delivery. No clinical plan selection is automated.

s1 verifies the actual existing clinical plan. s2 produces procedure id, quantity, stage and selected price-table version/entry. The existing price owner provides valid prices; maintenance is unchanged with no saving attributed to that owner. Missing prices or nonstandard items are investigated manually, not invented.

Conditional E1 estimates apply where arithmetic and document copying are manual today, not existing automatic estimate runtime. Native configuration precedes code. Final document checking is actual generated-output and recipient verification, not an added self-approval of a routine save; any change voids the s8 release reference and requires renewed checking.
unknowns: Are estimates already calculated and templated natively?
How often are custom items or changed treatment stages needed?
research_questions: Can item selection, total, caveats and patient identity be reproduced from the exact actual plan and price version?

already_counted.description: Actual treatment/price selection, patient discussion, complete output check and delivery

incremental.description: Check price/template mappings and patient-output tests after updates

approvals.approved_version: Exact final patient document v1 and recipient checked after all changes at the end of s6; unchanged in s7; any revision voids the release decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 arithmetic plus 20 template assembly = 40 minus 2 upkeep gives 38. Conservative case: nonstandard treatment items lack current structured prices and the existing software already assembles the standard document, so retain manual custom estimates without adopting a new generator. Clinical selection, explanation and full output checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise patients on following treatment plans

steps.what: Review the actual current treatment plan and recent progress in the orthodontic record {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual current patient plan and progress record

steps.what: Ask the patient about actual difficulties following the plan, listening for discomfort, misunderstanding and practical barriers.
Advise the patient on following the actual treatment plan, explaining the reasons, checking understanding and agreeing practical responses to the barriers.
outputs: Actual tailored advice and patient understanding

steps.what: Write the actual advice, patient concerns and agreed follow-up in the clinical note {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual tailored advice and concerns from s2-s3

steps.what: Save the actual advice note in the same clinical record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Retain the direct plan review, patient conversation and separately written advice note in {OTHER}. Native note headings may already help organise it, but the actual new patient concerns and tailored advice still need capture; no reminder campaign or automatic adherence judgement is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding why this patient struggles is the work, rather than a missing automation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records support plan access; no new technical change is assumed for this encounter.
tasks.still_hard: Practical barriers and discomfort cannot be inferred from an appointment or message event.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and adapt advice to the actual patient's circumstances.
tasks.altitude: No change in clinical decision rights or the encounter.

reach.learn: Identify actual barriers and communicate them without assigning blame.

evidence.claim: A patient's actual barriers and understanding require direct conversation; record headings do not supply the new facts.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual plan lookup, barrier discussion, tailored advice, separate note writing and same-system save. No record write is hidden in the conversation.

The existing clinical record provides the current plan; the patient supplies actual barriers in s2 and the orthodontist produces actual advice in s3. No structured adherence feed, recording or free transcript is assumed.

Conditional E1 shares. Native plan views and note headings are considered, but there is no evidenced repeated transfer or reducible administrative field task here. New concerns and advice retain their actual capture time; no extra reminder, report or approval baseline is invented.
No new tool or changed workflow is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. The routine internal save has no gate and no saving.
unknowns: Is there an actual repeated record transfer or separate follow-up send outside this direct encounter?
research_questions: Observe actual note writing before proposing automation; distinguish repeated headers from new patient-specific content.

already_counted.description: All actual plan review, conversation, tailored advice and separate record writing

incremental.description: No changed workflow or new tool to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: This direct encounter has no changed step after separating the actual note and save. Native headings do not capture new patient concerns or provide tailored advice, and no existing duplicate entry or actual send is evidenced; retain all work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some record assembly and estimate arithmetic may shrink; diagnosis, treatment planning and patient-specific advice stay with the orthodontist.
reach: Coordinate diagnostic uncertainty with dentists and oral/maxillofacial surgeons
Explain plan and estimate limits clearly to patients
role.ambitious_version: Clear patient plans and traceable estimates without delegating clinical judgement.
